items.text: SeAn-CP searches three families of planes and stays within 3.8 % of a full critical-plane scan.
Every multifat criterion on one load-equivalent error scale, across six materials.

Welding and metal AM process windows collapse onto one dimensionless power–velocity plane.
A structural stress at the rivet brings lap-shear and coach-peel joints onto one S–N curve, scatter band ×2.
